# Test fixtures

Everything under `documents/` is synthetic: fabricated for tests, never a
real patient record. Each file declares that on its first comment line.

The fixtures exercise schema-v2 unitization and multi-file chunking only.
Model-authored grounding, assembly, and review artifacts are generated by
the deterministic test harness so no fixture can preserve a direct-summary
or fail-open publication route.

If de-identified real documents are later approved, add them alongside the
synthetic set without relabeling fabricated content or removing these files.
